evidence.quote: Unfortunately, DS-Agent with the open-source LLM still exhibits weaker performance than agents with GPT-3.5 or GPT-4, attributable to its inferior foundational LLM capabilities.
As DS-Agent navigates the vast terrain of possible solutions to a given data problem, it may inadvertently produce code that is inefficient, vulnerable to exploitation, or even directly harmful.
when integrating API-based Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-3.5 or GPT-4, there is an inherent privacy risk since these interactions typically involve transmitting data to external servers.
